user.title: Terms of Service
user.description:
Before using this integration, please acknowledge:

1. For research and personal use only.
2. You are responsible for any account or IP blocking issues caused by frequent requests.
3. Data accuracy and real-time availability are not guaranteed.

**Check below to accept these terms.**

data.accept_terms: I accept the terms and conditions

device_verification.title: Device Verification (Risk Control)
device_verification.description: The server requires SMS verification to confirm device identity. A code was sent to number ending {phone_suffix}. Enter the 6-digit code.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The system will automatically re-run the ritual using the saved password. If the password changed, you can re-enter it next. {auth_error}

reauth_credentials.title: Update Password
reauth_credentials.description: Enter the current account password to complete re-authentication.

error.terms_not_accepted: You must accept the terms to proceed.
error.invalid_username_format: Invalid username format. Please use a mobile number.
error.interactive_challenge_unsupported: Interactive risk control is not auto-passable ({error_code}): {error_message}
error.local_error: Failed to build the request locally ({error_type}): {error_message}

init.title: Integration Settings
init.description: Data syncs automatically once a day (the time is fixed per account, spread across 9:00-21:00). No manual configuration needed.
